item.title: KMA Alumni Association Opposes Hasty Integration of Army, Navy, and Air Force Academies (육사 총동창회 “육·해·공군사관학교 졸속 통합 반대”)
item.description:
The Alumni Association of the Korea Military Academy (KMA) expressed "deep concern over the weakening of national security that would result from the hasty push to integrate the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies," demanding a complete review of the integration plan from scratch. (육군사관학교(육사) 총동창회가 “육·해·공군 사관학교 통합 졸속 추진이 가져올 국가 안보 약화에 깊은 우려를 표한다”며 3군 사관학교 통합을 원점에서 재검토하라고 요구했다.)

In a statement distributed to the media on the 16th, the KMA Alumni Association said the Ministry of National Defense is pushing forward a policy to establish a "National Defense Academy" (tentative name) that would jointly select cadets from the Army, Navy, and Air Force academies, provide common education for freshmen and sophomores, and allow juniors and seniors to choose their service branch for specialized education. The association stated, "Training elite officers for battlefields evolving into high-tech warfare is a critical matter directly linked to national survival, yet the Ministry of National Defense is unilaterally and hastily pushing forward the integration of the academies without objective research, military academic validation, or serious communication with experts." It argued that integrating the academies would limit the cultivation of identity and expertise in officer training, ultimately weakening combat capability. (육사 총동창회는 16일 언론에 배포한 입장문에서 국방부가 ‘국군사관학교'(가칭)를 창설해 육·해·공군 사관학교 생도들을 통합 선발하고, 1·2학년엔 공통 교육을, 3·4학년엔 군을 선택해 군별 특화 전공교육을 받도록 하는 사관학교 통합 정책을 추진하고 있다고 밝혔다. 육사 총동창회는 “첨단과학기술전으로 진화하는 전장에서 정예 장교 양성은 국가 생존과 직결된 중대사인데 국방부는 객관적인 연구나 군사학적 검증, 전문가와 진지한 소통이 없는 채 일방적이고 졸속으로 사관학교 통폐합을 추진하고 있다”고 했다. 총동창회는 사관학교가 통합될 경우 장교 양성에서 정체성과 전문성 함양이 제한되고, 이는 결국 전투력 약화로 이어질 수 있다고 주장했다.)

The association reported that the Ministry of National Defense is actively considering relocating the KMA from its current location in Taereung, Nowon-gu, Seoul to Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla Province. The area in Jangseong-gun houses the Sangmudae complex, which includes five Army branch schools such as the Army Infantry School, and there is idle land owned by the Ministry near there, prompting the proposed relocation. (총동창회는 현재 서울 노원구 태릉에 있는 육사를 전남 장성군으로 이전하는 방안이 국방부 내에서 유력하게 검토되고 있다고 전했다. 장성군에는 육군보병학교 등 5개 육군 병과학교가 모인 상무대가 있는데, 상무대 근처에 국방부 소유 유휴지가 있어 이곳으로 육사 이전이 추진되고 있다는 것이다.)

The association argued, "If the KMA moves to Jangseong, it could lead to a qualitative decline in the educational foundation, including restrictions on attracting top talent and faculty and diverse educational exchanges." In response, the Ministry of National Defense explained, "The relocation of the KMA to Jangseong-gun, South Jeolla Province, has not been confirmed yet." (총동창회는 “육사가 장성으로 이전할 경우 우수 인재·교수 유치와 다양한 교육 교류에 제한이 되는 등 교육 기반의 질적 저하를 초래할 수 있다”고 주장했다. 이에 대해 국방부는 “육사 전남 장성군 이전은 현재 확정되지 않았다”고 설명했다.)

While acknowledging that "some negative actions by officers from certain military academies in the past are very regrettable," they insisted, "The integration should not be pushed through hastily without in-depth expert verification and public consensus." (이들은 “과거 일부 사관학교 출신 장교들의 부정적 행적은 매우 유감스러운 일”이라면서도 “전문가들의 심도 있는 검증과 국민적 공감대 없이 졸속으로 통합이 추진돼서는 안 된다”고 주장했다.)

The "Citizens' Solidarity for Protecting the Future of National Defense," composed of KMA cadet parents, also issued a statement on the same day, stating, "Since (the integration of military academies and the relocation of the KMA) is a critical issue that shakes the foundation of national security and the framework for training elite officers, prior review and social consensus must come first." The group argued, "Above all, the voices of cadets and military personnel, who are the direct stakeholders and potential victims of the policy, should be given absolute priority." (육사 생도 학부모 등으로 꾸려진 ‘국방의 미래를 지키는 시민연대’도 이날 성명을 내어 “(사관학교 통폐합과 육사 이전은) 국가안보의 근간이자 정예 장교 양성 체계의 틀을 흔드는 중대한 사안인 만큼, 사전 검토와 사회적 합의가 선행되어야 한다”고 밝혔다. 이 단체는 “무엇보다 정책의 직접적인 이해 당사자이자 피해자가 될 수 있는 생도와 군 구성원들의 목소리가 절대적으로 우선 반영되어야 마땅하다”고 주장했다.)

Regarding questions about the integration of military academies at a regular briefing on the same day, Ministry of National Defense spokesperson Jeong Bit-na said, "We are not using the term 'integration,' and the plan to establish a National Defense Academy has not been finalized yet," adding, "There is consensus on the need for reform measures to train future elite officers, so we are developing specific plans to further specialize each service branch's expertise and create an overall premier educational institution." (정빛나 국방부 대변인은 이날 정례브리핑에서 사관학교 통폐합 관련 질문에 대해 “통폐합이란 용어는 저희가 사용하고 있지 않고, 국군사관학교 창설 방안이 아직 확정되지 않았다”며 “미래정예장교 양성을 위해서 개혁 방안이 필요하다는 것에는 공감대가 있어서, 각 군 전문성을 더 특화하고 전체적인 명품 교육기관을 창설하기 위한 구체적인 방안을 마련하고 있다”고 말했다)

Reporter Kwon Hyuk-cheol nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Foreign Ministry Recruiting UNESCO Official from North Korea for Jeju Forum (외교부, ‘제주포럼’에 북한 출신 유네스코 인사 섭외 중)
item.description:
The international academic conference "Jeju Forum," scheduled to take place on Jeju Island from the 24th to the 26th, is recruiting a North Korean official to participate, drawing attention to whether it will be realized. The Jeju Forum, launched by Jeju City in 2001, is co-hosted this year with the Ministry of Foreign Affairs. (오는 24~26일 제주에서 열리는 국제학술회의 ‘제주포럼’ 쪽이 북한 인사의 참여를 섭외하고 있어 성사 여부에 관심이 모인다. ‘제주포럼’은 2001년 제주시가 출범한 국제학술회의로 올해 행사는 외교부와 공동 주최한다.)

According to a summary of explanations from the Ministry of Foreign Affairs and the Ministry of Unification on the 16th, the Jeju Forum side is pursuing the recruitment of Dr. Jang Gwang-cheol, the Head of the Education Policy Section in the Policy and Lifelong Education Division at UNESCO Headquarters. A Unification Ministry official met with reporters that day and stated, "The organizing side of the (Jeju Forum) reported contact with a North Korean resident, and (the Ministry of Unification) accepted it." (16일 외교부와 통일부 설명을 종합하면, 제주포럼 쪽은 유네스코 본부 정책·평생교육국 교육정책 부서장인 장광철 박사 섭외를 추진하고 있다. 통일부 당국자는 이날 기자들과 만나 “(제주포럼) 주최 쪽에서 북한 주민접촉신고를 했고, (통일부가) 이를 수리했다”고 밝혔다.)

If Dr. Jang's recruitment succeeds, he will virtually participate in the session "UNESCO and the Future of Education: Challenges and Prospects" on the final day, the 26th, becoming the first North Korean official to attend the Jeju Forum. Additionally, it could serve as an example of inter-Korean exchange within the framework of an international event since North Korea defined inter-Korean relations as "hostile two-state relations." There is also a precedent last month when a North Korean hometown women's football team visited the South and played an international match in Suwon, Gyeonggi Province. (장 박사 섭외가 성사될 경우, 마지막날인 26일 ‘유네스코와 교육의 미래: 도전 및 전망’ 세션에 화상으로 참여하게 되고, 제주포럼에 참석하는 첫 북한 인사가 된다. 또, 북한이 남북관계를 ‘적대적 두 국가’ 관계로 정의한 이래 국제 행사의 틀 안에서 남북이 교류하는 사례가 될 수 있다. 지난달 북한 내고향여자축구단이 방남해 경기 수원에서 국제경기를 치른 선례도 있다.)

However, the Unification Ministry official added, "It has not yet been determined whether (Dr. Jang) will attend, and we will have to wait and see." So far, no notification of a change in participants has been reported from the UNESCO side. (다만 통일부 당국자는 “(장 박사가) 참석할지는 아직 정해지지 않았고, 지켜봐야 할 것 같다”고 말했다. 현재까지 유네스코 쪽에서 참석자 변경 통보는 없는 것으로 전해졌다.)

Dr. Jang is an education expert with a diverse career at UNESCO. He served as Acting Head of the UNESCO Office for West Africa and the Sahel, and as a Senior Programme Specialist at the UNESCO Asia-Pacific Regional Bureau for Education and the UNESCO Office in Dakar. At UNESCO Headquarters, he developed various educational programs, including education rights and policy analysis, as well as early childhood care and education. Before joining UNESCO, he worked at the North Korean Ministry of Education. He earned his Ph.D. in education from Kim Hyong Jik University of Education in North Korea. (장 박사는 유네스코에서 다양한 경력을 쌓은 교육 전문가다. 유네스코 서아프리카와 사헬 지역사무소 소장 대행, 유네스코 아시아·태평양 교육지역사무국과 다카르 사무소에서 선임 프로그램 전문가 등으로 활동했다. 유네스코 본부에서는 교육권과 교육 정책 분석, 영유아 보육과 교육 등 다양한 교육 프로그램을 개발했다. 유네스코에 합류하기 전엔 북한 교육성에서 일했다. 그는 북한 김형직사범대학에서 교육학 박사학위를 받았다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Noh Geon-ho: "Yoo Si-min, a Valuable Intellectual... Also Aware of Kwak Sang-eon's Concerns" (노건호 “유시민, 귀중한 지식인…곽상언 문제의식도 인지”)
item.description:
Noh Geon-ho, the son of the late former President Roh Moo-hyun, issued a statement regarding author Yoo Si-min, who recently stepped down as standing advisor to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation, stating that "Regardless of political alignment or personal preferences, he deserves respect and high regard as a valuable intellectual." (고 노무현 전 대통령의 아들 노건호씨가 최근 노무현재단 상임고문직을 내려놓은 유시민 작가에 대해 “정치적 노선이나 개인적 호불호를 떠나 귀중한 지식인으로 존중받고 높게 평가받는 것이 마땅하다”는 입장을 냈다.)

In a statement released on the 15th, Noh said about Yoo, "I believe that his role in drawing the attention of (Roh Moo-hyun Foundation) members and citizens and leading intellectual yet accessible discussions is a contribution to the foundation and a social contribution that others cannot easily replace." ( 노씨는 지난 15일 낸 입장문에서 유 작가에 대해 “(노무현재단) 회원들과 시민들의 관심을 모으고 지적이면서도 접근 가능한 담론들을 이끌어 주신 데 대해서도, 다른 이들이 쉽게 대체할 수 없는 재단에 대한 기여이자 사회적 공헌으로 생각하고 있다”며 이렇게 밝혔다.)

Earlier on the 12th, Kwak Sang-eon, a member of the Democratic Party of Korea and son-in-law of the late President Roh, pointed out on his YouTube channel that "Out of 2,010 videos on the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation's YouTube channel, only 360 are related to former President Roh, yet Yoo appears in 68% of all videos." He also mentioned the recent live broadcast of Yoo's book launch event on the foundation's YouTube channel, saying, "I'm not sure who the foundation's YouTube channel and website are actually promoting. If a bakery doesn't sell bread but promotes the baker, it's a promotion agency, not a bakery." <<> In response, Yoo Si-min issued a statement on the 15th saying, "I requested the foundation to remove me from my post as standing advisor. This is to prevent any potential difficulties the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation might face in the future due to the critical activities I will undertake," and the foundation accepted his request for removal as standing advisor. <<> Noh wrote, "Representative Kwak's remarks and judgments are entirely his own, and it is not a matter for me to step in and intervene. However, I am fully aware of the long-held thoughts and concerns that Representative Kwak has." He added, "Although we are now witnessing some tumultuous and unpleasant conflicts, the essence of politics has always been a struggle for power, and all of this will pass. What matters is what remains after a sandstorm passes. I ask you to firmly hold the flag and stay with the foundation." <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 앞서 지난 12일 노 전 대통령의 사위인 곽상언 더불어민주당 의원은 자신의 유튜브 채널에서 ‘노무현재단 유튜브 채널 동영상 2010개 가운데 노 전 대통령 관련 콘텐츠는 360개에 그치지만, 전체 영상의 68%에 유 작가가 등장한다’고 지적했다. 또 최근 노무현재단 유튜브 채널에서 유 작가의 출판기념회를 생중계한 점 등도 언급하며 “노무현재단의 유튜브·홈페이지가 실질적으로 누구를 홍보한다고 봐야 하는지 모르겠다. 제과점이 빵을 팔지 않고 빵 만드는 사장을 홍보한다면 이건 홍보업체지 제과점이 아니다”라고 했다. )

item.title: People Power's Han Ji-ah Criticizes 'Jang Dong-hyuk for Seeking Consent from Illegal Polling Station Protesters and Negotiating' (국힘 한지아 “장동혁, 불법 개표소 시위대 동의 구하고 협상” 비판)
item.description:
Han Ji-ah, a lawmaker of the People Power Party, criticized party leader Jang Dong-hyuk over his mediation between employees of sports organizations attempting to enter their office inside the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Seoul and protesters blocking the polling station, stating that 'rather than resolving the illegality, he sought the consent of the protesters and negotiated.' <<> In a Facebook post on the same day, Han said, 'Minister of Justice Chung Sung-ho stated that private interrogations, facility occupations, and access controls are clearly illegal. What was confirmed at the Olympic Park was the disappearance of the rule of law and police authority,' adding, 'What is even harder to understand is the behavior of leader Jang.' <<> Han criticized, 'Leader Jang did not resolve the illegality but rather sought the consent of the protesters and negotiated. Even the employees of the sports organizations entering their own office was left to the permission of the protesters. South Korea is a country governed by the rule of law. It is not a country where protesters decide who can enter, and politicians mediate this.' Han added, 'Leveraging public anger, another illegality should not be tolerated.' <<> Employees of sports organizations affiliated with the Korean Sport & Olympic Committee, who have been blocked from entering the building for 12 days, attempted to enter the handball gymnasium again starting the morning, but the protesters reacted with shouts and intense emotions, citing 'the possibility of removing ballot boxes and ballots.' After negotiations with the protesters and People Power Party lawmakers including leader Jang, the employees accepted conditions including: △ placing two broadcast cameras capable of live streaming △ allowing entry by two people per organization in turns △ conducting bag checks upon exiting the building. <<> However, with one participant wearing a Star-Spangled Banner around their waist clinging to the door handle, the employees' entry into the office ultimately failed. On-site, leader Jang, holding a megaphone, said, 'One person is currently blocking the entrance. It's not a situation where we can enter,' adding, 'If even one person is blocking that door, I have no intention of forcing this today.' <<> The police launched an investigation into the protesters who prevented the employees from entering the office on the same day, on charges of obstructing business, among others. The Songpa Police Station stated, 'We will immediately begin an investigation based on the evidence and strictly handle legal proceedings.' <<> Reporter Kwang-jun Jeon light@hani.co.kr (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 16일 서울 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 안에 있는 사무실에 진입하려는 체육단체 직원들과 ‘개표소 봉쇄’ 시위대 간 협의를 중재한 것을 두고 한지아 국민의힘 의원이 “불법을 해소한 것이 아니라 시위대의 동의를 구하고 협상했다”고 비판했다.)

item.title: 45-Day National Audit of Election Commission…Ruling Party to Head Special Committee (‘선관위 국정조사’ 45일간 실시…특위위원장은 국힘서 맡기로)
item.description:
The Democratic Party of Korea and the People Power Party agreed on the 16th to conduct a national audit tentatively titled “Investigation into the Infringement of Citizens’ Voting Rights, Such as the Ballot Paper Shortage Incident, and Reform of Election Management.” (더불어민주당과 국민의힘이 16일 ‘투표용지 부족 사태 등 국민 참정권 침해 진상 규명 및 선거 관리 개혁을 위한 국정조사’(가칭)에 합의했다.)

Chun Jun-ho (Democratic Party) and Kim Seung-su (People Power Party), senior deputy chiefs of the National Assembly’s floor leaders’ office, held two meetings at the parliament that day and agreed to present a plan for the national audit concerning the “ballot paper shortage incident” that occurred during the June 3 local elections to the plenary session on the 18th for approval. Chun told reporters, “We agreed to the national audit to promptly uncover the truth behind the infringement of citizens’ voting rights and to prepare legislation that can comprehensively reform the National Election Commission.” Kim added, “The Ministry of the Interior and Safety is also involved in the situation, so regarding witness requests, we agreed that both parties would actively cooperate in selecting the Minister of the Interior and Safety, public officials, and relevant public officials from cities, counties, and districts where the ballot paper shortage occurred as witnesses.” (천준호(민주당)·김승수(국민의힘) 원내운영수석부대표는 이날 국회에서 두차례 만난 뒤 6·3 지방선거 당시 벌어진 ‘투표용지 부족 사태’에 대한 국정조사계획서를 오는 18일 본회의에서 처리하기로 합의했다. 천 수석부대표는 기자들에게 “국민 참정권 침해 상황에 대한 진상을 조속히 규명하고 선거관리위원회를 대대적으로 개혁할 수 있는 법안을 마련하는 차원에서 국정조사에 합의했다”고 밝혔다. 김 수석부대표는 “행정안전부도 (사태에) 관련이 돼 있어서, 증인 신청에 있어 행안부 장관과 공무원들, 그리고 투표용지 부족 사태가 발생한 시·군·구 관계 공무원 증인 채택에 (양당이) 적극적으로 협조하기로 합의했다”고 말했다.)

The agencies subject to the national audit are the National Election Commission and election commissions at all levels. The investigation period is 45 days, and it can be extended if additional investigation is needed. The chairperson of the Special Committee on the National Audit will be from the People Power Party. The committee will consist of an equal number of members from the ruling and opposition parties (9 vs. 9), following National Assembly convention: 9 from the Democratic Party, 7 from the People Power Party, and 2 from non-bargaining groups. The allocation of seats for non-bargaining groups will be decided by the National Assembly Speaker. (국정조사 대상 기관은 중앙선거관리위원회와 각급 선관위다. 조사 기간은 45일이고, 추가 조사가 필요하면 기간을 늘릴 수 있다. 국정조사 특별위원회 위원장은 국민의힘이 맡기로 했다. 국조특위 위원은 국회 관례대로 여야 동수(9 대 9)로 하기로 했다. 민주당 9명, 국민의힘 7명, 비교섭단체 2명이다. 비교섭단체 위원 배분은 국회의장이 정한다.)

Meanwhile, at a meeting of the Democratic Party’s Task Force (TF) for “Protecting Citizens’ Voting Rights and Institutional Reform” held that day, a “two-stage reform plan” for the National Election Commission was proposed. Democratic Party lawmaker Kim Young-bae, who serves as the TF deputy head, stated, “In the first stage, we should pursue legislative reforms by the regular session of the National Assembly this year, including introducing a permanent chairperson system for the Election Commission, expanding standing members, and establishing an independent audit body within the Election Commission.” He added, “Regarding constitutional amendments, including explicitly stipulating the Board of Audit and Inspection’s authority to audit the Election Commission, these should be pursued in the second stage early next year.” In response, TF member Lee Joo-hee said, “Starting with a discussion forum on the 17th to hear experts’ opinions, we will intensively prepare institutional improvement measures by the next meeting,” and indicated that Kim’s proposed two-stage reform plan “can be positively considered.” (한편 이날 민주당 ‘국민 참정권 수호를 위한 제도개혁 태스크포스(TF)’ 회의에서는 선관위에 대한 ‘2단계 개혁안’ 제안이 나왔다. 티에프 부단장을 맡은 김영배 민주당 의원은 “선관위원장 상임 제도를 도입하고 상임위원을 확대하는 것과 함께, 선관위 내부에 독립적 감사 기구를 설치하는 법안 등 입법을 통한 개혁을 올해 정기국회까지 1단계로 추진해야 한다”며 “감사원의 (선관위) 감사 제도 명시를 비롯한 개헌 문제에 대해서는 내년 초 2단계로 추진해야 한다”고 했다. 이에 대해 티에프 위원인 이주희 의원은 “17일 전문가들의 의견을 듣는 토론회를 시작으로 다음 회의까지 집중적으로 제도 개선 방안을 마련할 것”이라며 김 의원이 제안한 2단계 개혁안도 “충분히 긍정적으로 검토할 수 있다”고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr (김채운 기자 cwk@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae says "The party's owners are its members"... Lowering posture while showing intent to run in party convention (정청래 “당의 주인은 당원”…몸 낮추면서도 전대 출마 의지)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, who faces calls to resign and not run due to responsibility for the June 3 local elections, emphasized the Democratic Party's historical legitimacy stretching from Kim Dae-jung to Roh Moo-hyun, Moon Jae-in, and Lee Jae-myung on the 16th, stating, "The party's owners are its members." Regarding Jung's repeated emphasis on member sovereignty, observers inside and outside the party interpret this as an indirect expression of his intent to run in the party convention. (6·3 지방선거 책임론으로 대표직 사퇴 및 불출마 요구를 받는 정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 16일 ‘김대중-노무현-문재인-이재명’으로 이어지는 민주당의 역사적 정통성을 강조하며 “당의 주인은 당원”이라고 했다. 정 대표가 당원 주권론을 거듭 부각한 것에 대해 당 안팎에서는 전당대회 출마 의지를 우회적으로 드러낸 것이라는 해석이 나온다.)

At the Central Committee meeting held at the National Assembly on the 16th, Representative Jung said, "Until the people's sovereignty government was born, there was the blood and sweat of countless people who supported Presidents Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in," adding, "We must use the history of Kim Dae-jung, Roh Moo-hyun, and Moon Jae-in as nourishment to further flourish the history of Lee Jae-myung." Jung then quoted President Lee Jae-myung's remark that "Politics seems to be done by politicians, but in the end, it is done by the people," and added, "Party operations also seem to be done by the party leader, but ultimately, it is done by the party members." Furthermore, Jung emphasized the importance of the "one-member-one-vote system for delegates and rights-bearing members," stating, "History has seen many people shed blood to obtain the right to vote with one person, one vote, based on universality, equality, directness, and secrecy." <<> After sparking controversy on the 10th with the remark, "The people are eternal, and governments are short-lived," Representative Jung has been lowering his posture while minimizing confrontation with President Lee. On this day as well, he said, "I ask for generous applause and support for President Lee, who spares no effort on the diplomatic front." <<> Meanwhile, the emphasis on 'member-centeredness' is interpreted as an appeal for support and unity from party members, ultimately expressing his intent to run in the party convention. The fact that Jung has been notably highlighting the one-member-one-vote system, which party members support, reinforces this interpretation. The one-member-one-vote system equalizes the voting value of delegates and rights-bearing members in elections for the party leader and supreme council members, and Jung previously pushed this through despite internal opposition. A party leadership official said, "Representative Jung appears to have the will to run." <<> Within the party, it is seen that around the 18th, when President Lee returns from his European tour, will be a watershed moment for Jung's decision on whether to run in the party convention. Rep. Han Min-soo, Jung's chief of staff, said on SBS radio on this day, "Would the ruling party leader publicly discuss his own position during the president's overseas visit? I don't think he will do that." This implies that even if Jung states his position, it will be after President Lee's return. President Lee did not call Jung before departing for Europe on the 9th, and attention is focused on whether he will invite Jung to the homecoming event. A multi-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "For the sake of Representative Jung, the Democratic Party, and the president alike, the controversy should be resolved at least by this week." <<> Prime Minister Kim Min-seok and Rep. Song Young-gil, mentioned as potential contenders for party leadership, attended a workshop for elected members of the Democratic Party-affiliated South Jeolla-Gwangju Integrated Special City council members held in Boseong, South Jeolla, on this day. Honam is a region where one-third of rights-bearing members are concentrated, and this move is seen as targeting the hearts of Honam voters in the party convention. <<> Meanwhile, observations suggest that author Yoo Si-min, who stepped down as a standing advisor to the Roh Moo-hyun Foundation on the 15th, may provide indirect support for Representative Jung in the party leadership race. Regarding his resignation from the standing advisor role, Yoo stated, "It is to prevent any potential difficulties the foundation might face due to my future critical activities." Another multi-term lawmaker from the metropolitan area said, "He seems to have the will to play a direct role in the current conflict situation." <<> Reported by Go Han-sol sol@hani.co.kr and Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr ( 정 대표는 16일 국회에서 열린 중앙위원회의에서 “국민주권정부가 탄생할 때까지 김대중·노무현·문재인 대통령을 지지했던 수많은 사람들의 피와 땀이 있었다”며 “우리는 김대중·노무현·문재인의 역사를 자양분 삼아 이재명의 역사를 더욱 꽃피워야 한다”고 했다. 정 대표는 이어 ‘정치는 정치인이 하는 것 같지만 결국은 국민이 한다’는 이재명 대통령의 발언을 인용하며 “당 운영도 당대표가 하는 것 같지만 결국 당원이 한다”고 덧붙였다. 아울러 정 대표는 “역사는 보통·평등·직접·비밀의 1인 1표 투표권을 얻기 위해 수많은 사람이 피를 흘렸다”며 ‘대의원-권리당원 1인 1표제’의 중요성을 강조했다.)

item.title: 'Maldives and Kota Kinabalu business trips' by the National Election Commission...Noh Tae-ak spent 84 million won on one trip (몰디브·코타키나발루 ‘선관위 출장’…노태악 ‘1회 8400만원’ 지출)
item.description:
Amid public outcry over the National Election Commission's (NEC) poor election management, highlighted by the ballot shortage during the June 3 local elections, it has been confirmed that over the past five years, NEC employees have made 107 overseas trips involving 461 personnel. Some of the destinations included popular resort spots such as the Maldives and Kota Kinabalu. (6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태로 중앙선거관리위원회의 부실한 선거 관리가 사회적 질타를 받는 가운데, 최근 5년간 선관위 직원들이 지난 5년간 107회에 걸쳐 461명이 국외 출장을 다녀온 것으로 확인됐다. 출장지 중에는 대표적 휴양지로 꼽히는 몰디브·코타키나발루 등도 있었다.)

According to the 'Status of NEC Employees' Overseas Trips Over the Past Five Years' received by People Power Party lawmaker Kim Ki-hyun on the 16th, NEC employees took a total of 107 overseas trips from 2022 to June of this year. The trips involved 461 people, with a total budget of 2.45255 billion won. By year, there were 29 trips (815.8 million won) in 2022, 30 trips (690.15 million won) in 2023, 20 trips (346.21 million won) in 2024, 26 trips (581.28 million won) in 2025, and 2 trips (33.31 million won) this year. (김기현 국민의힘 의원이 16일 중앙선거관리위원회에서 받은 ‘최근 5년간 선관위 직원 국외출장 현황’을 보면, 2022년부터 올해 6월까지 선관위 직원들은 총 107차례 국외 출장을 떠났다. 출장 인원은 461명, 총 소요 예산은 24억5255만원이었다. 연도별로는 2022년 29건(8억158만원), 2023년 30건(6억9015만 원), 2024년 20건(3억4621만 원), 2025년 26건(5억8128만원), 올해는 2건(3331만원)의 국외 출장이 이뤄졌다.)

The destinations included major resort areas such as the Maldives, Thailand, Malaysia, and Kota Kinabalu. (출장지 중에는 몰디브, 타이, 말레이시아, 코타키나발루 등 대표적 휴양지가 포함됐다.)

Lawmaker Kim's office reported that a trip in September 2023, under the guise of observing the Maldives presidential election, cost about 14.7 million won for five employees. Another trip in November of the same year, cited as a check on the readiness for overseas voting, sent five staff to Thailand, Malaysia, and Kota Kinabalu, using approximately 19.2 million won in budget. (김 의원실은 2023년 9월 몰디브 대선 참관 명목으로 직원 5명이 다녀온 출장에는 약 1470만원이 투입됐고, 같은 해 11월 재외선거 준비 상황 점검을 이유로 타이·말레이시아·코타키나발루를 방문한 출장에는 5명이 약 1920만원의 예산을 사용했다.)

Some destinations were visited repeatedly for the same purpose. In 2022, 10 employees traveled to Florence and Milan, Italy for the purpose of "capacity building," spending about 30 million won. The following year, in 2023, nine employees visited Florence and Venice for the same reason, also spending about 30 million won. In 2025, five employees again went to Florence for the same purpose, spending 22.9 million won. Lawmaker Kim claimed that the 2022 Italy training trip report even included visits to historical and cultural sites like the Duomo Cathedral, the Uffizi Gallery, and the Vatican. <<>= A trip last November, aimed at studying poor election management cases in Germany, cost about 19.7 million won for four people. Another trip in November of the same year to Denmark and Sweden, accompanied by former NEC Chairperson Noh Tae-ak, required a budget of about 84 million won. (동일한 목적으로 같은 지역을 반복적으로 가기도 했다. 2022년 직원 역량 강화 목적으로 이탈리아 피렌체·밀라노 등에 간 10명이 약 3000만원을 사용했는데, 다음 해인 2023년에도 9명이 같은 목적으로 피렌체·베네치아 등을 방문하는 데 약 3000만원을 썼다. 2025년에도 같은 목적으로 5명이 피렌체를 방문하는 데 2290만원을 사용했다. 특히 2022년 이탈리아 연수 결과보고서에는 두오모 대성당, 우피치 미술관, 바티칸 등 역사·문화 탐방 내용이 포함됐다고 김 의원은 주장했다.)

The trip reports submitted afterward were also lacking. A report from a trip last year, where six employees spent 13 million won to analyze Japan's postal and onboard voting systems, contained only general remarks: "It was confirmed that while the election systems of Japan and Korea are similar in broad terms, there are differences in operational methods due to political and cultural environmental differences." The 2022 Germany training trip report included a note: "We saw that the tragic historical sites in each city are well preserved." (지난해 11월 독일의 선거관리 부실사례를 공부하겠다고 떠난 출장에는 총 4명이 약 1970만 원을 사용했고, 사퇴한 노태악 전 위원장이 동행한 지난해 11월 덴마크·스웨덴 출장에는 약 8400만 원의 예산이 들어갔다.)

Lawmaker Kim said, "The NEC has been criticized for poor elections and incompetence for years, but even their overseas trips have been conducted poorly," adding, "At this point, it's no exaggeration to call it not just a 'dream job' but a divine one. Thoroughly investigate these cases of budget waste to assign responsibility." (출장 뒤 제출된 결과보고서도 부실했다. 지난해 일본의 우편·선상투표 제도 분석을 위해 6명이 1300만원을 들여 다녀온 출장 결과보고서에는 “일본과 한국의 선거제도는 큰 틀에서는 비슷하면서도 정치적·문화적 환경 차이로 운영방식에 차이점이 있음을 확인했다”는 원론적인 내용이 쓰였다. 2022년 독일 연수 결과보고서에는 “각 도시에서 벌어진 비극적인 역사의 현장도 잘 보존하고 있음을 알 수 있었다”는 내용이 기재됐다.)

Reporter Yoo Young-jae young@hani.co.kr (김 의원은 “선관위가 수년 전부터 이미 부실선거와 무능으로 질타받고 있었지만, 정작 선관위는 해외 출장마저 부실하게 다녀온 것”이라며 “이쯤 되면 ‘신의 직장’이 아니라 신 그 자체라고 해도 과언이 아니다. 예산 낭비 사례를 철저히 조사해 책임소재를 가려내야 한다”고 말했다.)

item.title: Government begins communication with US and Iran over Hormuz Strait passage… "Opposed to tolls" (정부, 미·이란 상대 호르무즈 통항 소통 시작…“통행료 반대”)
item.description:
Following the US-Iran agreement to end hostilities, the government has initiated communication with the US and Iran to facilitate the passage of South Korean vessels stranded in the Hormuz Strait. However, with thousands of ships anchored in the strait, safely extracting our vessels in the near future is expected to be no easy task. (미국과 이란의 종전 합의에 정부가 호르무즈해협에 발이 묶인 우리 선박들의 통항을 위해 미국·이란과 소통에 나섰다. 다만 수천여 척의 배가 해협에 정박 중인 상황에서 이른 시일 안에 우리 선박을 안전하게 빼내는 일은 만만치 않을 전망이다.)

Ministry of Foreign Affairs spokesperson Park Il stated at a regular briefing on the 16th, "The government is aware of the detailed circumstances regarding vessel passage and has begun necessary communication with relevant countries, including the US and Iran," adding, "To assess the feasibility of passage, we need a comprehensive consideration of various factors, such as the overall security situation in the strait, including the presence of mines, the speed of the strait's opening, and available routes." (박일 외교부 대변인은 16일 정례브리핑에서 “정부는 선박 통항과 관련된 상세 내용을 파악하고 있으며, 이를 위해 미국·이란 등 관련국과 필요한 소통을 시작했다”며 “통항 (가능성을) 판단하기 위해서는 기뢰 유무 등 해협의 전반적인 안전 상황, 해협의 개방 속도, 이용 가능한 항로 등 여러 사항에 대한 종합적인 고려가 필요하다”고 말했다.)

Amid conflicting positions between the US and Iran over imposing passage tolls in the strait, the government has maintained its stance that such tolls are unacceptable. Spokesperson Park said, "The freedom of safe passage through the Hormuz Strait, an international waterway, must be fully guaranteed," and emphasized, "We hold the fundamental position that no passage fees or charges should be imposed." While the US has indicated that the strait could be used freely without tolls, Iran's Revolutionary Guard has reportedly suggested that a 'fee' will be charged 60 days after the cessation of hostilities. (해협 통항료 부과를 두고 미국과 이란의 입장이 상반되는 가운데 정부는 이를 인정할 수 없다는 입장을 유지했다. 박 대변인은 “국제 해협인 호르무즈해협의 안전한 통항의 자유가 전면 보장돼야 한다”며 “어떠한 통항료, 수수료도 부과되지 않아야 한다는 기본 입장을 갖고 있다”고 말했다. 미국은 통행료 부과 없이 호르무즈해협을 자유롭게 이용할 수 있을 거라는 입장이지만, 이란 혁명수비대는 종전 이후 60일이 지나면 ‘수수료’를 받을 것이라는 이야기가 나오고 있다.)

Beyond the toll issue, various variables must be examined, including the status and safety of available routes after the conflict ends, and the possibility of mine clearance operations. In particular, it remains uncertain whether all South Korean vessels can exit within the 60-day period stipulated by Iran. A Foreign Ministry official said on the same day, "Once the US and Iran sign the memorandum of understanding on the 19th, we need to see how quickly the strait will open, so it's difficult to say right now when our ships will be able to leave," adding, "Wouldn't all countries, including ours, be trying to get their vessels out within those 60 days?" Currently, 24 South Korean ships and 137 South Korean crew members remain in the Hormuz Strait. (통항료 문제 외에도 종전 이후 이용할 수 있는 항로 상황과 안전 여부, 기뢰 제거 작업 가능성 등 여러 변수를 살펴야 한다. 특히 이란이 제시한 60일 이내에 우리 선박들이 모두 나올 수 있을지도 미지수다. 외교부 당국자는 이날 “오는 19일 (미·이란이) 양해각서에 서명하면 해협이 어느 정도나 빠르게 개방될지를 봐야 하기 때문에 지금은 언제 우리 선박이 빠져나갈 수 있을지 말하기 어렵다”며 “우리뿐 아니라 모든 나라들의 (선박이) 60일 이내에 나오려고 하지 않겠느냐”고 말했다. 호르무즈해협에 우리 선박은 24척, 한국인 선원은 137명이 남아있다.)

Following the agreement to end hostilities, foreign media reports suggest that South Korea may participate in a US-led fund for Iran's reconstruction. However, it has been reported that no specific proposal regarding reconstruction projects has yet been received by the government from the US. Spokesperson Park stated, "We view the reconstruction fund as an issue raised within the framework of US-Iran negotiations, and the specifics will depend on the outcome of those talks," adding, "Our country will play a constructive role in the reconstruction process in the Middle East." (종전 합의 이후엔 미국이 주도하는 이란 재건 기금 조성에 한국이 참여할 수 있다는 외신 보도가 나오고 있지만 현재까지 정부 차원에서 미국으로부터 재건 사업 관련 제안을 받은 바는 없는 것으로 전해졌다. 박 대변인은 “재건 기금은 미-이란의 협상 틀 속에서 제기되는 사안으로 생각하고 있고, 구체적인 것은 협상 결과를 지켜봐야 한다”며 “우리나라는 중동 지역의 재건 과정에 건설적인 역할을 할 것”이라고 말했다.)

Reporter Jang Ye-ji penj@hani.co.kr (장예지 기자 penj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: A Power Game Ignited by Ballot Papers… The People Power Party's 'By-election Civil War' and the Democratic Party's 'Jeong Cheong-rae's Status' [Gongdeok Pocha] (투표용지가 불붙인 권력 게임…국힘 ‘재선거 내전’·민주 ‘정청래 거취’ [공덕포차])
item.description:
The People Power Party (PPP) is in turmoil after pulling out the 'by-election' card in response to the shortage of ballot papers during the June 3 local elections. This has led to the rare sight of the winning Seoul Mayor, Oh Se-hoon, directly targeting his own party leader. (국민의힘이 6·3 지방선거 투표용지 부족 사태를 두고 ‘재선거’ 카드를 꺼내 들면서 당이 통째로 흔들리고 있습니다. 정작 선거에서 이긴 오세훈 서울시장이 자기 당대표를 직격하는 보기 드문 장면까지 나왔습니다.)

The trigger was the emergency Supreme Council meeting on the 15th. The PPP decided to file election petitions in six regions, including Seoul, Incheon, Gyeonggi, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju-Jeonnam, with Representative Jang Dong-hyuk as the petitioner. The aim is to determine whether the ballot shortage affected the election results, which is why Seoul, where Mayor Oh won, was also included. However, regarding the same decision, Representative Jang's side argued it was a procedure for a 'full by-election,' while floor leader Jeong Jeom-sik drew a line, saying it was not a demand for a by-election. (발단은 15일 긴급 최고위원회의였습니다. 국민의힘은 서울·인천·경기·부산·울산·광주전남 등 6개 지역에 대한 선거 소청을 결정했고, 소청권자는 장동혁 대표였습니다. 투표용지 부족 사태가 선거 결과에 영향을 미쳤는지 가려달라는 취지라서, 오 시장이 이긴 서울도 대상에 포함됐습니다. 하지만 같은 결정을 두고 장 대표 쪽은 ‘전면 재선거’를 위한 절차라 주장했고, 정점식 원내대표는 재선거 요구가 아니라며 선을 그었습니다.)

Representative Jang went a step further on the 16th. He stated, "The petition is just the beginning," and "It is right to hold by-elections nationwide." He even went directly to the Jamsil counting station, where protests had been ongoing for 12 days, and declared, "I will fight to the end to stop it." (장 대표는 16일 한발 더 나아갔습니다. “소청은 시작에 불과하다”며 “전국적으로 재선거를 시행하는 게 맞다”고 밝혔고, 12일째 시위가 이어지던 잠실 개표소 현장에 직접 나가 “끝까지 싸워 막아내겠다”고 외쳤습니다.)

Mayor Oh Se-hoon immediately fired back. He said, "Representative Jang is driving the entire party into a wasteful argument for a by-election," and added, "The public knows whether this is a political slogan to protect his own shaky political position." The PPP plans to hold a general meeting of lawmakers on the 17th to discuss the election petition and Representative Jang's future. (오세훈 시장은 곧장 직격탄을 날렸습니다. “장 대표가 온 당을 소모적인 재선거 주장으로만 몰아가고 있다”며 “자신의 흔들리는 정치적 입지를 지키기 위한 정략적 구호인지 국민은 알고 있다”고 했습니다. 국민의힘은 17일 의원총회를 열어 선거 소청과 장 대표 거취 등을 논의하기로 했습니다.)

In the paradox of rising approval ratings while the party splits, is Representative Jang Dong-hyuk's 'nationwide by-election' a bold move to uncover the truth, or just a slogan to hold onto his position? To ensure that the parliamentary investigation into the ballot shortage, agreed upon by both ruling and opposition parties, goes beyond a one-time blame game and leads to real electoral management system reform, what is needed? Amid falling approval ratings, what choice will Democratic Party leader Jeong Cheong-rae make between seeking re-election and stepping down ahead of the August party convention? Find out at 'Gongdeok Pocha.' Check out the video! (지지율은 오르는데 당은 쪼개지는 역설 속에서, 장동혁 대표가 내건 ‘전국 재선거’는 진상 규명을 위한 승부수일까요, 아니면 자리를 지키기 위한 구호일까요? 여야가 합의한 투표용지 부족 사태 국정조사가 일회성 책임 추궁에 그치지 않고 실질적인 선거관리 시스템 개혁으로 이어지려면, 무엇이 필요할까요? 지지율이 떨어지는 가운데, 정청래 더불어민주당 대표는 8월 전당대회를 앞두고 연임 도전과 사퇴 사이에서 어떤 선택을 내리게 될까요? ‘공덕포차’에서 알아봅니다. 영상으로 확인하시죠!)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon Fires Back at Jang Dong-hyuk’s ‘Re-election Claim’: “Nothing More Than a Slogan to Protect His Position” (오세훈, ‘재선거 주장’ 장동혁 직격…“입지 지키려는 구호 불과”)
item.description:
Intra-party controversy is escalating over the moves of People Power Party leader Jang Dong-hyuk, who has taken his grievances outside the party by advocating for expanded election petitions and a “nationwide re-election.” Criticism is mounting that Jang is pushing for re-elections without gathering internal party opinions, using it as a shield to protect his leadership post. (선거소청 지역 확대와 ‘전국 재선거’를 주장하며 장외로 향한 장동혁 국민의힘 대표의 행보를 둘러싸고 당내 논란이 증폭되고 있다. 장 대표가 당내 의견 수렴 없이 재선거 드라이브를 걸며 이를 대표직을 지키는 방패막이로 삼는다는 비판이 터져 나온다.)

Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon on the 16th issued a direct hit on Facebook and in a statement, saying, “Leader Jang is driving the entire party into a draining ‘re-election claim’,” adding, “The public already knows clearly. Is it a struggle for truth, or is it a strategic slogan to defend his own shaky political position?” He further stated, “The pure aspirations of young people should not be consumed as fuel for a specific politician’s political survival.” (오세훈 서울시장은 16일 페이스북과 입장문에서 “장 대표는 온 당을 소모적인 ‘재선거 주장’으로만 몰아가고 있다”며 “국민은 이미 똑똑히 알고 계신다. 그것이 진실 규명을 위한 투쟁인지 아니면 자신의 흔들리는 정치적 입지를 지키기 위한 정략적 구호인지”라고 직격탄을 날렸다. 그는 “청년들의 순수한 열망이 특정 정치인의 정치적 생존을 위한 연료로 소비돼선 안 된다”고 덧붙였다.)

Younger-lawmaker Kim Yong-tae also said, “He is leading the party with the conspiracy theory of election fraud and a path to save his political position,” and argued, “The leadership must be replaced.” A lawmaker from the Yeongnam region expressed concern, saying, “Using re-election as a political slogan might be acceptable for an opposition leader, but directly stepping out of the party to incite re-election is a different matter. Abandoning duties in the National Assembly and rallying ‘hardline supporters’ outside could backfire even more.” Another lawmaker from the Seoul metropolitan area remarked, “Isn’t this a move to consolidate hardline supporters and prepare for something like a party member vote of confidence for himself?” <<> Jang announced that day he would submit election petitions to the National Election Commission for seven regions, including Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, Gwangju/Jeonnam, and North Chungcheong, arguing for a nationwide re-election. He visited the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, to call for a re-election. When faced with demands to resign as party leader, he dismissed them, saying, “That would create a vacuum until the end of the year, leaving us unable to say anything about the ballot shortage.” <<> Views on Jang’s re-election claim are divided even within the leadership. It is known that Floor Leader Jeong Jeom-sik told younger lawmakers, “The election petition is not aimed at re-election.” A lawmaker who attended a meeting of five-term lawmakers hosted by Jeong that day also told The Hankyoreh, “The prevailing view was that a nationwide re-election is not realistically feasible.” <<> The conflict is expected to surface at a general meeting of lawmakers on the 17th, convened at the request of 14 lawmakers from the young-lawmaker group “Alternative and Future.” A second-term lawmaker said, “It’s unfortunate that Leader Jang is only using the ballot issue to extend his term, deepening internal strife. At the general meeting, we need to first clarify the party’s stance on re-election.” <<> By Kim Hae-jeong and Cho Hee-yeon, reporters: sea@hani.co.kr (소장파인 김용태 의원도 “부정선거 음모론과 자신의 정치적 입지를 살리는 길로 당을 이끌고 있다”며 “리더십을 교체해야 한다”고 했다. 한 영남권 의원은 “재선거를 정치적 구호로 활용하는 것까진 야당 대표로서 할 수 있다 해도 직접 장외로 나가 재선거를 선동하는 건 다른 얘기”라며 “국회에서 해야 하는 역할을 내던지고 장외에서 ‘짠물’을 결집하면 역풍이 더 커질 것”이라고 우려했다. 한 수도권 의원 역시 “강성 지지층을 결집해 자신에 대한 당원 재신임 투표 등에 대비하는 행보 아니겠나”라고 했다.)

item.title: Jang Dong-hyuk leads ‘PPP power faction,’ calling for “full re-election” as an external rallying cry (장동혁, ‘국힘 당권파’ 이끌고 “전면 재선거” 장외 구호)
item.description:
Jang Dong-hyuk, leader of the People Power Party (PPP), has been pushing the party toward an external struggle for re-election by rallying lawmakers from the party’s power faction and rushing to the vote-counting blockade protest site on the 16th, with “national re-election” at the forefront. Critics say he is stoking social chaos over the “National Election Commission crisis” to protect his own political interests in maintaining his leadership position. (장동혁 국민의힘 대표가 16일 “전국 재선거”를 전면에 내걸고 당권파 의원들과 개표소 봉쇄 시위 현장에 달려가며 당을 재선거 장외 투쟁 국면으로 몰아가고 있다. 대표직 유지라는 자신의 정치적 이익을 지키려 ‘선거관리위원회 사태’에 대한 사회적 혼란을 부추긴다는 비판이 나온다.)

On this day, Jang visited the “vote-counting blockade protest” site at the Olympic Handball Gymnasium in Songpa-gu, Seoul, where police and protesters were in a standoff. He said, “What citizens want now is a re-election, a special counsel, and reform of the National Election Commission,” adding, “The PPP will protect this place alongside the citizens.” The previous day, he wrote on Facebook, “Starting today, as a citizen and as the PPP leader, I will go to the Olympic Park.” Lawmakers classified as part of the power faction—Park Jun-tae, Park Chung-kwon, Kim Jang-kyom, Kim Min-jeon, Kim Mi-ae, Kim Tae-kyu, Choi Soo-jin, Park Dae-chul, Seo Cheon-ho, and Seo Myung-ok—also appeared at the site. (장 대표는 이날 경찰과 시위대가 대치한 서울 송파구 올림픽공원 핸드볼경기장 ‘개표 봉쇄 시위’ 현장을 찾았다. 그는 “지금 시민이 원하는 건 재선거, 특검, 선거관리위원회 개혁”이라며 “국민의힘은 시민들과 함께 이곳을 지키겠다”고 말했다. 그는 전날 페이스북에 “오늘부터 저는 시민의 한 사람이자, 국민의힘 당대표로서 올림픽공원에 간다”고 적었다. 당권파로 분류되는 박준태·박충권·김장겸·김민전·김미애·김태규·최수진·박대출·서천호·서명옥 의원 등도 현장에 모습을 나타냈다.)

Before visiting the protest site, Jang appeared on Munhwa Ilbo’s YouTube show “Heo Min’s News Show” and announced plans to file election petitions for a full re-election in seven regions: Seoul, Gyeonggi, Incheon, Busan, Ulsan, and Gwangju/Jeonnam, with the addition of North Chungcheong Province. He said, “We intend to file an election petition for North Chungcheong as well, where the voter list was lost,” adding, “By tomorrow, we will identify all problematic areas and expand the scope to cover as much of the nation as possible.” (장 대표는 시위 현장 방문 전 문화일보 유튜브 ‘허민의 뉴스쇼’에 나와 서울·경기·인천·부산·울산·전남광주 지역에 충북을 추가해 총 7개 지역에 전면 재선거를 위한 선거소청을 제기하겠다고 밝혔다. 그는 “선거인 명부가 없어진 충북도 추가로 (선거소청을) 하려고 한다”며 “내일까지 추가로 문제 지역을 다 찾아서 소청할 수 있는 부분을 전국 최대로 확대하겠다”고 말했다.)

Both inside and outside political circles, there are criticisms that Jang, far from resolving the NEC situation, is exacerbating conflict and confusion through irresponsible incitement. (정치권 안팎에서는 장 대표가 선관위 사태를 수습하기는커녕 무책임한 선동을 하며 갈등과 혼란을 키운다는 비판이 나온다.)

Han Byung-do, floor leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said at a party strategy meeting in the National Assembly, “It’s like performing a rain ritual at the Olympic Park, endlessly repeating conspiracy theories,” and called for “an immediate withdrawal of the indiscriminate petitions and conspiracy-mongering.” Lee Jun-seok, leader of the Reform Party, also wrote on Facebook, “Shouting ‘It’s all invalid, let’s do it again’ without a plan for how to redo it is not a solution but irresponsible incitement.” (한병도 더불어민주당 원내대표는 이날 국회 원내대책회의에서 “올림픽공원에서 인디언식 기우제를 지내듯 음모론을 무한 반복하고 있다”며 “묻지마 소청과 음모론 선동을 즉각 철회하라”고 말했다. 이준석 개혁신당 대표도 페이스북에 “(전국 재선거를) 어떻게 다시 할지 설계하지 못하면서 ‘다 무효, 다시 하자’고 외치는 것은 해법이 아니라 무책임한 선동”이라고 말했다.)

Professor Lee Jun-han of Incheon University (political science and diplomacy) stated, “As a former judge, he should be able to fully assess the feasibility of a national re-election, but he is amplifying social chaos by relying on hardline supporters to maintain his position as party leader.” (이준한 인천대 교수(정치외교학)는 “법관 출신으로 전국 재선거의 현실성 등을 충분히 판단할 수 있을 텐데, 당대표직 유지를 위해 강성 지지층에 기대며 사회적 혼란을 증폭하고 있다”고 말했다.)

Reported by Jang Na-rae, Jeong Bong-bi, and Yoo Young-jae wing@hani.co.kr (장나래 정봉비 유영재 기자 wing@hani.co.kr)

item.title: President Lee meets Trump at G7, asks him to "lead resolution of North Korea issue" (이 대통령, G7서 트럼프 만나 “북한문제 해결 주도해달라”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung attended the welcoming event for invited countries at the Group of Seven (G7) summit in Évian-les-Bains, France, on the 16th (local time) and exchanged greetings with President Donald Trump. (이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 프랑스 에비앙레뱅 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 초청국 환영행사에 참석해 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 인사를 나눴다.)

Senior Press Secretary Kang Yoo-jung stated, "President Lee greeted President Trump during the G7 group photo session," adding, "President Trump asked President Lee about the current state of inter-Korean relations, and President Lee requested that President Trump take the lead in peacefully resolving the North Korean issue, just as he resolved the Middle East conflict." Kang reported that President Trump responded positively, expressing his intention to "work towards resolving the North Korea issue." <<> Upon President Lee's arrival at the welcoming event, French President Emmanuel Macron, who was waiting, approached him, shook hands, and embraced him. President Lee smiled and said, "I'm so happy." President Lee spoke with President Donald Trump for about 40 seconds before the leaders took the group photo. <<> President Lee held separate bilateral talks with German Chancellor Friedrich Merz and Canadian Prime Minister Mark Carney on the sidelines of the G7 summit. President Lee told Chancellor Merz, "I believe Germany and the Republic of Korea can cooperate in many areas and create synergies through collaboration." Chancellor Merz responded, "The Republic of Korea is highly regarded in Germany, and the cooperation so far has been progressing well. I plan to visit Korea at the end of October and hope to see you again then." <<> In his meeting with Prime Minister Carney, President Lee said, "Since there is much we can cooperate on, let's discuss today what specific collaborations we can pursue." Notably, as South Korea is participating in the bid for Canada's next-generation submarine acquisition project, related discussions are likely to have taken place. Prime Minister Carney remarked, "We have strengthened cooperation in various fields, including defense, investment, and culture." <<> Earlier, President Lee posted on X (formerly Twitter), "Being invited to the conference for the second consecutive year is a very meaningful event that demonstrates the international community's trust and expectations toward the Republic of Korea." He added, "I plan to engage in in-depth discussions with leaders from G7 member countries and other invited nations on key agenda items of the era, such as international solidarity, growth for all, and the direction of development for artificial intelligence (AI) and future technologies." <<> Évian/Seo Young-ji reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 강유정 수석대변인은 “이 대통령은 주요 7개국 정상회의 단체촬영 과정에서 트럼프 대통령과 만나 인사를 나눴다”며 “트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령에게 남북관계의 근황을 물었고, 이재명 대통령은 트럼프 대통령이 중동 전쟁을 해결한 것처럼 북한문제의 평화적 해결을 주도해 달라고 요청했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “북한문제의 해결을 위해 노력하겠다”는 의사를 밝히며 화답했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다. )

item.title: President Lee: "Korea Was a Recipient of Aid"... Proposes New Direction for Development Cooperation at G7 (이 대통령 “한국은 원조받던 나라”… G7서 개발협력 새 방향 제시)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung attended the first session of the Group of Seven (G7) summit on the 16th (local time) and stated, "Based on the experience and capacity of growing from a 'recipient of aid' to a 'donor nation,' the South Korean government will fulfill its responsibilities and roles in building international partnerships." (이재명 대통령이 16일(현지시각) 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 첫 세션에 참석해 “대한민국 정부는 ‘원조받던 나라’에서 ‘원조하는 나라’로 성장한 경험과 역량을 바탕으로, 국제 파트너십을 구축해 나가는 데 나름의 책임과 역할을 다하겠다”고 밝혔다.)

President Lee participated in the first expanded session of the G7 summit, titled "Building New Partnerships and Rebuilding International Solidarity," held in Évian-les-Bains, France. He discussed with attending leaders ways to enhance the self-reliance capacity of recipient countries—those receiving development aid—through development cooperation, as well as develop mutually beneficial partnerships between recipient and donor nations. The session included leaders from the seven member countries and five invited nations, including India, Brazil, Kenya, and Egypt. The President of the World Bank (WB) and the President of the African Development Bank (AfDB) also attended. ( 이 대통령은 이날 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 주요 7개국(G7) 정상회의 확대회의 첫 세션인 ‘새로운 파트너십 구축과 국제연대 재건’에 참석해 참석한 정상들과 개발협력을 통해 개발원조를 받는 수원국의 자립 역량 제고와 수원국과 공여국간 상호 호혜적인 파트너십 발전 방안에 대해 논의했다. 이번 회의에는 주요 7개국 회원국과 인도, 브라질, 케냐, 이집트 등 5개국 초청국 정상 등이 참석했다. 세계은행(WB) 총재와 아프리카개발은행(AfDB) 총재도 참석했다.)

President Lee noted, "Although the AI revolution presents new challenges and opportunities for human growth, many developing countries still lack sufficient access to these opportunities." He emphasized a new partnership where aid, investment, technology, and institutions move in unison, proposing three directions. ( 이 대통령은 “인공지능 혁명은 인류의 새로운 도전이자 성장의 기회임에도 불구, 많은 개도국들이 이러한 기회에 충분히 접근하지 못하고 있다”며 원조와 투자, 기술과 제도가 함께 움직이는 새로운 파트너십을 강조하며 세 가지 방향을 제시했다. )

First, President Lee stated, "Amid shrinking budgets for development aid to underdeveloped countries, we must open new paths for growth in recipient countries through private investment." He added, "To achieve this, private investment and domestic resources of partner countries must be mobilized together, with public funds playing a role in facilitating this." President Lee further said, "We must support recipient countries so that technological gaps between nations do not lead to growth gaps. It is paramount to share the outcomes of AI technological advancements with all nations of the world and grow together." To this end, South Korea has presented a vision of a "Global AI Basic Society," where the benefits of AI technology development are shared by all humanity. ( 먼저 이 대통령은 “저개발국에 대한 개발 원조 예산이 축소되는 상황에서 민간투자를 통해 수원국(원조 수혜국)에게 새로운 성장의 길을 열어줘야 한다”며 “이를 위해 민간 투자와 파트너국의 국내 재원이 함께 동원되어야 하며, 공적 재원은 이를 촉진하는 역할을 수행해야 한다”고 말했다. 이 대통령은 이어 “각국의 기술 격차가 성장 격차로 연결되지 않도록 수원국들을 지원해야 한다면서, 인공지능(AI)의 기술 발전에 따른 결과물을 모든 세계 국가와 공유하고 함께 성장하는 것이 무엇보다 중요하다”고 덧붙였다. 이를 위해 대한민국은 인공지능 기술 발전의 혜택을 모든 인류가 함께 누리는 ‘글로벌 인공지능 기본사회’ 비전을 제시했다. )

Additionally, President Lee emphasized, "The success of development cooperation depends not only on the scale of resources invested but also on how much the lives of people in recipient countries actually change. For this, we must maximize the practical effectiveness of development cooperation." ( 아울러 이 대통령은 “개발 협력의 성과는 투입된 재원의 규모뿐만 아니라 수원국 국민의 삶이 실제로 얼마나 변화하는지에 달려있다면서 이를 위해 개발 협력의 실질적 효과를 최대한 제고해야 한다”고 강조했다. )

Meanwhile, France, the chair of the G7, adopted three documents after the session: "Mutually Beneficial International Partnerships," "Fighting Cancer," and "Responding to Ebola." South Korea expressed support for these documents, reaffirming solidarity with the G7 and key partner countries in the areas of development cooperation and health security. ( 한편 주요 7개국(G7) 의장국인 프랑스는 이날 세션 종료 후 ‘상호 호혜적 국제파트너십', ‘암 퇴치', ‘에볼라 대응' 등 3개 문서를 채택했다. 한국도 이들 문서에 대한 지지를 표명하며 개발협력과 보건안보 분야에서 주요 7개국 및 주요 파트너국들과의 연대를 재확인했다.)

Évian/Seo Young-ji Reporter yj@hani.co.kr ( 에비앙/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: [On-site] The 'Hefei Model' of China's High-Tech Rise: Four Key Words ([현장] 중국 첨단기술 굴기 ‘허페이 모델’의 4가지 열쇳말)
item.description:
Orange robotic arms moved busily, effortlessly lifting car bodies and welding non-stop with bursts of sparks. On the floor, white transport robots scurried about carrying automotive parts. Human workers were seen only very rarely. (주황색 로봇팔들이 부지런히 움직이며 차체를 가뿐하게 들어올리고 불꽃을 튀기며 쉼 없이 용접을 한다. 바닥에서는 흰색 운반용 로봇이 자동차용 부품을 나르느라 분주하다. 인간 노동자의 모습은 아주 가끔 보일 뿐이었다.)

At the F2 factory of NIO (Chinese name: Weilai), a Chinese premium electric vehicle brand located in the Xinqiao NEO Park in Hefei, Anhui Province, visited on the 12th, robots and artificial intelligence (AI) are used to produce one electric vehicle per minute. Completed assembly vehicles move autonomously to self-inspect over 1,000 functions through their internal systems. Approximately 1,300 production robots and over 500 transport robots are 'at work'. A company official stated, "An internet network is installed underground in the factory to collect 1.5 terabytes (TB) of process data daily," adding, "The goal is to automate even decision-making in the future." <<> This state-of-the-art factory, expanding with the aim of becoming the 'world's largest electric vehicle production base', is one of the places showcasing Hefei's transformation into a high-tech city. As a central inland city in China, Hefei was once an 'underdeveloped metropolis' called a 'huge rural village' until about a decade ago. However, strategic investments led by the Hefei city government, combined with the central government's 'Yangtze River Delta Integration' strategy (a collaborative development strategy encompassing Shanghai, Anhui, Jiangsu, and Zhejiang, championed by President Xi Jinping in 2018), have borne fruit, resulting in explosive growth. In the first quarter of this year, Hefei grew by approximately 6.8% year-on-year, ranking first in growth rate among China's 29 major cities. <<> Just as Shenzhen in southern Guangdong Province leaped forward in the 1980s as a capitalist laboratory and symbol of reform and opening-up—capturing attention with its 'Shenzhen speed' and 'Shenzhen model'—the 'Hefei speed' and 'Hefei model' now symbolize a new path for the Chinese economy. While the Shenzhen model represented private-led growth amid reform, opening-up, and globalization, the Hefei model showcases China's new strategy in an era of security where globalization is ending, amid the high-stakes high-tech competition between the U.S. and China. <<> The first key word is the government's pivotal role. Hefei City operates five investment funds under its jurisdiction, including Hefei Industry Investment and Singtai Capital. In 2008, it temporarily halted subway construction and poured one-third of local fiscal revenue to attract BOE, a display company that was then running losses of over 1 billion yuan. BOE is now the world's largest display manufacturer, ranking first globally in LCDs and second in OLEDs. In 2013, it secured a 37% stake through massive investment in semiconductor company CXMT (Changxin Memory Technologies). Subsequently, as the U.S. imposed semiconductor sanctions on China, 'semiconductor self-reliance' became a core national task, and CXMT grew into a representative Chinese semiconductor company. <<> Going a step further, Hefei City invested 7 billion yuan in 2020 in NIO, an electric vehicle company then on the verge of bankruptcy, to attract its headquarters and production factory. This prompted BYD, Volkswagen, and others to establish electric vehicle factories there. Battery companies also grew alongside, forming a major ecosystem for the electric vehicle industry. Lu Xiaomei, Deputy Director of Hefei City's Foreign Affairs Office, said, "As Hefei's government investments all succeeded, leading to rapid development of its high-tech industries, many people call Hefei a 'gambling city' and pay attention to 'Hefei speed'." She added, "Hefei's success is not gambling; every investment was meticulously examined against development strategies and carefully studied." This refers to investments made according to a core strategic blueprint—'Xinpingqihe', meaning manufacturing development integrating semiconductors, displays, automobiles, and AI. <<> <<> The second key word is talent. At the campus of the University of Science and Technology of China (USTC), located in Hefei's northern old city center on the 12th, students were bustling even late at night, and buildings remained brightly lit. Entry is only possible after facial recognition identity verification at the main gate. This place is a hub for China's next-generation future industry research, including AI, quantum technology, nuclear fusion energy, aerospace, semiconductors, and brain-computer interfaces (BCI). <<> USTC, originally based in Beijing, sought a refuge in the 1970s to escape the chaos of the Cultural Revolution. Hefei City provided the best land in the city for its campus and closely cooperated by establishing national-level laboratories. In 2022, they jointly created a science and technology special zone called the 'USTC Silicon Valley'. According to a report by Xinjingbao, about 30% of USTC graduates remain in Hefei each year to start businesses or work, serving as a talent pool for the innovation ecosystem. <<> iFLYTEK, one of the world's leading AI voice recognition companies, also originated in 1999 from the Speech and Language Communication Laboratory of USTC. It was founded by Liu Qingfeng, then a doctoral student at USTC, along with fellow researchers. In iFLYTEK's Chinese name 'Keda Xunfei', 'Keda' refers to USTC. <<> The third key word is the supply chain ecosystem. With the formation of a massive supply chain ecosystem centered on electric vehicles, including solar power and batteries, a 'forest of high-tech industries' is being created, encompassing robots, drones, and energy storage systems (ESS). <<> Gotion High-tech, established in 2006, has grown into a leading Chinese battery manufacturer, ranking fifth globally in battery installations as of the first quarter, with a battery shipment volume of 30GWh, thanks to Hefei City's battery industry nurturing and R&D support. An official from Gotion High-tech's headquarters, met on the 11th, explained that Germany's Volkswagen invested approximately 1.1 billion euros for a 24-25% stake, and the company is equipped with everything from the battery raw material supply chain to energy storage systems. Sungrow, which started with solar inverters founded by former Hefei University of Technology professor Cao Renxian, has transformed into a comprehensive energy solution provider for wind, solar, and energy storage. <<> This is also why, in 2024, the Guangzhou-based drone company EHang established Heyi Aviation in Hefei's Luogang Park through a joint venture with Hefei City's state-owned capital platform. On the 11th, Gu Yong, the company's East China regional manager, stated, "We set up the company here considering Hefei City government's investment and support, abundant engineering talent including from USTC, and the supply chain ecosystem including battery and component companies needed for drone development." Luogang Park is a redevelopment of an old airport site, now hosting facilities like Huawei's R&D center and Heyi Aviation's drone test operation facilities, lined up in succession. Heyi Aviation is conducting test flights of autonomous air taxis here, where an impressive sight shows a drone carrying passengers—its propellers spinning rapidly with a whirring roar—forcefully pushing off the ground and soaring to 120 meters in an instant. <<> The development of the battery and drone industries has become the foundation for China to produce the most cost-effective and efficient supply chain for components needed in the humanoid robot industry. The New York Times (NYT) recently reported, "China has completely dominated the robot supply chain. Without China, it's nearly impossible to produce robots." <<> The final key word of the Hefei model is 'technological self-reliance amid U.S.-China technology competition'. At iFLYTEK's headquarters, visited on the 13th, AI products ranging from daily life to industrial applications were on display, including its self-developed AI model Spark, translation devices and earphones capable of interpreting 83 languages, translation glasses, and acoustic detectors for identifying faults in industrial settings. <<> iFLYTEK was placed on the U.S. government's blacklist in 2019 as the U.S.-China trade and technology competition intensified. Although it developed human-expert-level AI voice translation technology in 2018, from the following year it was cut off from receiving U.S.-made AI semiconductors. The U.S. raised concerns about iFLYTEK's technology potentially connecting with the Chinese military and being used for surveillance. In response, iFLYTEK accelerated its AI development using the Ascend chips from Huawei, which was also on the sanctions list. In 2023, in collaboration with Huawei, it launched 'Feixing-1', a computing platform for training large AI models, and is now advancing into developing its own AI and robots. Cheng Qian, head of iFLYTEK's AI translation division, said, "U.S. sanctions forced us down this path. It shows that sanctions cannot stop China's technological development." <<> Amid the intense U.S.-China competition, strategic industries supported by the Chinese government are developing rapidly, and the walls to block the outflow of high technology are rising. Government and corporate officials met in China from the 9th to 13th said that Korea should become a market open to Chinese high-tech products, but almost no one discussed technology cooperation or investment with Korea. Before entering factories, phones had to be covered with anti-photography stickers, and some companies outright refused to take questions. <<> In the era of national strategic industries for seizing high-tech supremacy, Korea's place within China is not easily visible. The reality of Korea becoming a 'market' for infinitely manufactured, highly price-competitive Chinese products and a 'target of containment' in high-tech competition deepens Korea's concerns. <<> Hefei/Nanjing/Park Min-hee Senior Correspondent minggu@hani.co.kr ( 지난 12일 찾은 중국 안후이성 허페이시 신차오 네오파크에 있는 중국 고급 전기차 브랜드 니오(중국명 웨이라이)의 에프(F)2 공장은 로봇과 인공지능(AI)을 활용해 분당 1대꼴로 전기차를 생산한다. 부품 조립을 마친 차량들은 자율주행으로 이동해 차량 내부 시스템으로 1000여가지 기능을 스스로 검사한다. 약 1300대의 생산용 로봇과 500여대의 운송용 로봇이 ‘일하고’ 있다. 회사 관계자는 “공장 지하에는 하루 1.5테라바이트(TB) 분량의 공정 데이터를 수집하는 인터넷망이 설치돼 있다”며 “앞으로 의사 결정까지 자동화하는 것이 목표”라고 말했다.)

item.title: President Lee Next to Trump Introduces Kim Hye-kyung as "My Wife" (트럼프 옆자리 이 대통령, 김혜경 여사 소개하며 “마이 와이프”)
item.description:
President Lee Jae-myung and First Lady Kim Hye-kyung attended a concert and official dinner hosted by French President Emmanuel Macron in Évian-les-Bains on the 16th (local time), alongside spouses of leaders from the Group of Seven (G7) member nations and invited countries. During the dinner, President Lee sat next to President Donald Trump, discussing key mutual interests between the two nations. (이재명 대통령과 김혜경 여사는 16일(현지시각) 주요 7개국(G7) 회원국과 초청국 정상 내외 등과 함께 프랑스 에비앙레뱅에서 열린 에마뉘엘 마크롱 프랑스 대통령이 주최한 음악회와 공식 만찬에 참석했다. 이 대통령은 만찬에서 도널드 트럼프 대통령과 나란히 앉아 양국의 주요 관심사를 논의했다.)

The presidential office stated in a press release that day, "President Lee and Mrs. Kim attended the concert hosted by Macron, enjoying diverse performances by artists and a children's choir." Notably, during a photo session after the concert, President Lee approached President Trump and personally introduced Mrs. Kim, saying "My wife." President Trump warmly shook hands with Mrs. Kim. (청와대는 이날 보도자료를 통해 “이 대통령과 김 여사가 마크롱이 주최한 콘서트에 참석해 아티스트들의 다채로운 연주와 어린이 합창 등을 감상했다”고 밝혔다. 특히 이 대통령은 콘서트가 끝난 뒤 기념촬영 시간에 트럼프 대통령에게 다가가 “마이 와이프”(My wife)라며 김 여사를 직접 소개하기도 했다. 트럼프 대통령은 김 여사와 반갑게 악수를 나누기도 했다.)

After the concert, President Lee and his wife joined the official dinner hosted by President Macron and First Lady Brigitte, interacting with leaders and their spouses from various countries, as well as representatives from international organizations. The presidential office reported that President Lee sat right next to President Trump at dinner, fostering friendship and camaraderie while closely discussing mutual interests. (콘서트가 끝나자 이 대통령 부부는 마크롱 대통령과 브리지트 여사가 주최한 공식 만찬에 참석해 각국 정상 내외 및 국제기구 대표 등과 교류했다. 이 대통령은 트럼프 대통령과 만찬 때 바로 옆자리에 앉아 우호와 친목을 도모하고, 긴밀히 상호 관심사를 논의했다고 청와대는 전했다.)

Earlier, President Lee met and exchanged greetings with President Trump during the group photo session of the G7 summit. Senior Spokesperson Kang Yu-jung stated, "President Trump asked President Lee about the current state of inter-Korean relations, and President Lee requested that President Trump lead a peaceful resolution to the North Korean issue, just as he resolved the Middle East war." In response, President Trump expressed his intention to "work toward resolving the North Korean issue," according to Senior Spokesperson Kang. (앞서 이 대통령은 주요 7개국 정상회의 단체촬영에서도 트럼프 대통령과 만나 인사를 나눴다. 강유정 수석대변인은 “트럼프 대통령은 이 대통령에게 남북관계의 근황을 물었고, 이재명 대통령은 트럼프 대통령이 중동 전쟁을 해결한 것처럼 북한문제의 평화적 해결을 주도해 달라고 요청했다”고 밝혔다. 이에 트럼프 대통령은 “북한문제의 해결을 위해 노력하겠다”는 의사를 밝히며 화답했다고 강 수석대변인은 전했다.)

Évian/Reporter Seo Young-ji yj@hani.co.kr (에비앙/서영지 기자 yj@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Lee Jin-sook: "Pizza with a bug, just swap that slice? ... No reason for Jang Dong-hyuk to resign" (이진숙 “벌레 나온 피자, 그 조각만 바꿔주면 되나…장동혁 사퇴 이유 없어”)
item.description:
Lee Jin-sook, a lawmaker from the People Power Party, said on the 17th, "The ruling party had an advantage (in the June 3 local and by-elections), and the People Power Party really performed well, but we cannot accept calling this a defeat or a crushing defeat," adding, "There is absolutely no reason for Party Leader Jang Dong-hyuk to resign." (이진숙 국민의힘 의원은 17일 “(6·3 지방선거 및 재보궐선거가) 여당이 유리한 상황에서 국민의힘이 정말 선방했는데, 우리 스스로 이걸 패배 또는 참패라고 하는 걸 받아들일 수 없다”며 “장동혁 대표가 사퇴할 이유가 전혀 없다”고 말했다.)

Appearing on YTN Radio's 'Jang Seong-cheol's News Myeongdang' on the same day, she said, "We were told to fight against the Lee Jae-myung regime, so why on earth are people from within calling for Leader Jang to step down? I truly cannot understand it." (그는 이날 와이티엔(YTN) 라디오 ‘장성철의 뉴스명당’에 나와 “이재명 정권하고 싸우라고 했는데 왜 도대체 내부에서 장 대표한테 물러나라고 하는지 도무지 이해할 수가 없다”며 이렇게 말했다.)

The lawmaker also compared the shortage of ballots to "pizza with a bug," describing it as "an incident of infringement on voting rights and democracy." She said, "You divide a pizza into 8 slices or 6 slices, and a bug is found in one slice. If the pizza shop owner says he'll just replace that one slice, what would you do? You'd think it's not just that one slice but the whole round pizza that has problems, and you might consider that all the pizzas that shop baked that day are problematic." (이 의원은 또, 투표용지 부족사태를 ‘벌레 나온 피자’에 비유하며 “참정권·민주주의 침탈 사건”이라고 규정했다. 그는 “피자를 8쪽, 6쪽으로 나눠주는데 한쪽에서 벌레가 나왔다. 피자집 주인이 벌레 나온 한 조각만 교체해준다고 한다면 어떻게 하느냐”며 “그 한쪽뿐 아니라 기본적으로 둥그런 전체 피자 모두에 문제가 있는 거라고 생각하고, 그 피자 가게가 그날 구워낸 피자 모두 문제가 있는 걸로 생각할 수 있다”고 말했다.)

Lee had participated in the 'Olympic Park Protest' along with lawmaker Na Kyung-won on the 14th. She added, "When Constitutional Court President Moon Hyung-bae ruled that the Board of Audit and Inspection could not conduct job audits on the (National Election Commission), I think this (ballot shortage) situation was already foreseen." (이 의원은 지난 14일 나경원 의원과 함께 ‘올림픽공원 시위’에 참여한 바 있다. 그는 “문형배 헌법재판소장이 (선거관리위원회에 대한) 감사원의 직무감찰을 할 수 없다는 결정을 했을 때 이미 이런 (투표용지 부족) 사태가 예견되지 않았나 생각한다”고 덧붙였다.)

The Constitutional Court ruled in February 2005 that the Board of Audit and Inspection's audit of the National Election Commission, an independent constitutional body, over alleged hiring favoritism was unconstitutional. However, it stated that being excluded from the job audit scope should not be misconstrued as immediately granting immunity for corrupt activities. (헌법재판소는 2005년 2월 감사원이 헌법상 독립기구인 중앙선거관리위원회의 채용 특혜 의혹을 감사한 것은 위헌이라고 판단했다. 다만, 감사원의 직무감찰 대상에서 배제된다고 해서 곧바로 부패행위에 대한 성역의 인정으로 호도되어서는 안 된다고 밝혔다.)

Reporter Lee Ji-eun jieuny@hani.co.kr (이지은 기자 jieuny@hani.co.kr)

item.title: Jung Cheong-rae: “Democratic Party Is All Pro-Lee…Factions Will Dissolve with One-Person-One-Vote System” (정청래 “민주당은 모두 친명…1인 1표제로 계파 소멸”)
item.description:
Jung Cheong-rae, leader of the Democratic Party of Korea, said on the 17th, “If the ‘one-person-one-vote system’ (for delegates and paid members) is implemented, factions within the party will disappear.” (정청래 더불어민주당 대표가 17일 “(대의원-권리당원) ‘1인 1표제’가 시행되면 당내 계파가 소멸될 것”이라고 말했다.)

At a party supreme council meeting held at the National Assembly that day, Representative Jung stated, “Party member sovereignty and the one-person-one-vote system are values that no one can deny,” adding, “Members of the National Assembly will focus on their legislative activities without worrying about the approval of factional bosses, and their political futures will be determined by evaluations from party members. Roh Moo-hyun’s dream of raising the banner of party democracy and reform will be realized, and Lee Hae-chan’s dream of advocating for a democratic people’s party will also come true.” The one-person-one-vote system equalizes the voting power of delegates and paid members in party conventions to elect the party leader and supreme council members, a measure that Representative Jung previously pushed through despite internal opposition. <<> Jung continued, “Some media are still obsessing over maliciously dividing us into factions like the Pro-Jung faction and the Pro-Kim Min-seok faction, which I don’t even recognize. Although I oppose and dislike being labeled under any faction, if I had to distinguish, I’d say I’m a party member faction and a reform faction,” adding, “All members of the Democratic Party are pro-Lee (supporting Lee Jae-myung) in wanting the success of the Lee Jae-myung government. In that sense, Democratic Party members and supporters are all party member sovereignty factions and reform factions.” Representative Jung and Prime Minister Kim Min-seok are considered strong candidates for the party leadership in the upcoming party convention on August 17. <<> Regarding President Lee Jae-myung’s overseas trips and schedule for the G7 summit, Representative Jung said, “President Lee’s actions, showing an irreplaceable South Korea on the global stage, will become the dignity and pride of our people,” adding, “As a South Korean citizen, I support President Lee.” <<> Meanwhile, regarding the “ballot shortage incident” in the June 3 local elections, Representative Jung stated, “The total inadequacy and incompetence revealed by the National Election Commission have exploded public distrust in election management and sparked outrage,” adding, “This ballot shortage should be used as a critical opportunity to strengthen our democracy and enhance national sovereignty.” He then targeted the People Power Party, saying, “Just as damaging as the NEC’s inadequacy and incompetence to our democracy is the People Power Party’s anti-constitutional and anti-democratic behavior through baseless election rigging conspiracy theories and refusal to accept election results,” adding, “What is needed now is a thorough investigation, punishment of those responsible, clear measures to prevent recurrence, and fundamental reform plans. Unsettling attempts to stir unnecessary social conflict and confusion for largely political purposes cannot be tolerated.” <<> Reporter Kim Chae-woon cwk@hani.co.kr Reporter Go Kyung-joo goh@hani.co.kr (정 대표는 이날 국회에서 열린 당 최고위원회의에서 “당원주권정당과 1인 1표제는 누구도 부정할 수 없는 가치”라며 “국회의원들은 계파 보스의 눈치를 보지 않고 의정 활동에 전념하고, 당원 평가에 의해 자신의 정치적 진로를 결정하게 된다. 정당 민주와 정당 개혁의 깃발을 올린 노무현의 꿈도 이뤄지고, 민주적 국민정당을 주창했던 이해찬의 꿈도 실현될 것”이라고 말했다. 1인 1표제는 당대표와 최고위원을 뽑는 전당대회에서 대의원과 권리당원의 표 가치를 같게 만드는 것으로, 앞서 정 대표가 당내 반대를 뚫고 관철한 바 있다.)

item.title: Oh Se-hoon: "'Jang Dong-hyuk Leadership' Has Reached Its End… Hope Discussion on Leadership Status at General Meeting of Lawmakers" (오세훈 “‘장동혁 지도부’ 수명 다해…의총서 거취 논의 이뤄지길”)
item.description:
Seoul Mayor Oh Se-hoon stated on the 17th, "The Jang Dong-hyuk leadership has already reached the end of its lifespan," and urged the People Power Party to discuss the leadership's status and the claim for a by-election at the general meeting of lawmakers. (오세훈 서울시장이 17일 “이미 장동혁 지도부는 수명을 다했다”며 국민의힘이 의원총회에서 지도부의 거취와 재선거 주장에 대해 논의해달라고 밝혔다.)

Mayor Oh made these remarks while arriving at the Seoul Central District Court in Seocho-gu, Seoul, on the same day. He said, "Jang Dong-hyuk's leadership has been dealt a decisive blow," and added, "I hope that at the general meeting of lawmakers, there will be thorough discussions focusing on the status of the Jang Dong-hyuk leadership, as well as on the point that the claim for a by-election is largely a tactical slogan to strengthen one's own political position." The People Power Party's general meeting of lawmakers is scheduled for 2 PM that day at the National Assembly. <<> When asked what would happen if Representative Jang continues to insist on a by-election despite opposition from lawmakers, Mayor Oh responded, "That is a matter for the party to decide on its own," and simply added, "It is not appropriate to comment on every such detail." <<> Mayor Oh attended the sentencing hearing for the so-called "Myung Tae-kyun Polling Scandal" on this day. He is accused of receiving poll results from Myung Tae-kyun a total of 10 times ahead of the April 7 by-election for Seoul mayor in 2021 and having donor Kim Han-jung pay the costs on his behalf (violation of the Political Funds Act). <<> By Jo Hee-yeon, Reporter choh@hani.co.kr (오 시장은 이날 서울 서초구 서울중앙지법에 출석하며 이렇게 말했다. 오 시장은 “장동혁 지도부 리더십이 결정적으로 타격을 받았다”며 “의원총회에서 장동혁 지도부의 거취와 아울러 재선거 주장이 다분히 본인의 정치적 입지를 강화하기 위한 정략적 구호라는 점에 초점을 맞춰 충분한 논의가 이뤄지기 바란다”고 했다. 국민의힘 의원총회는 이날 오후 2시 국회에서 열린다.)

item.title: Civilian Control Line to be Pushed North by Average 2km… Lifting of Restricted Zone 150 Times the Size of Yeouido Also Pursued (민통선 평균 2㎞ 끌어올린다…‘여의도 150배’ 제한보호구역 해제도 추진)
item.description:
The Ministry of National Defense plans to push the Civilian Control Line (CCL) northward by an average of about 2km and pursue the lifting of restricted protection zones covering an area 150 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul (approximately 450 sq km) as part of 'deregulation in the defense sector for military-civilian coexistence.' (국방부는 ‘민군상생을 위한 국방 분야 규제 완화’ 차원에서 민간인통제선(민통선)을 평균 2㎞ 가량 북상하고 서울 여의도 150배 규모(약 450㎢)의 제한보호구역 해제를 추진한다.)

Minister of National Defense An Kyu-baek announced on the 17th a military facility regulatory improvement plan containing these measures, stating that adjustments to the CCL would be pursued across border areas starting next year. The CCL is a baseline that controls civilian access in areas adjacent to the Military Demarcation Line (MDL) for military operational purposes. In principle, it is designated within 10km south of the MDL, but there are variations depending on terrain characteristics and operational needs. (안규백 국방부 장관은 17일 이런 내용이 들어간 군사시설 규제개선 대책을 발표해, 내년부터 접경지역 전반에 걸쳐 민통선 조정을 추진한다고 밝혔다. 민통선은 군사분계선(MDL) 인접지역에서 군사 작전상 민간인의 출입을 통제하는 기준선으로, 원칙적으로 군사분계선 이남 10㎞ 이내에 지정돼 있는데 지형 특성과 작전 필요에 따라 편차가 있다.)

Currently, the CCL is set at an average of 8km south of the MDL. After reviewing regional terrain and operational plans, the Ministry determined that the CCL can be adjusted to an average level of 6km. If adjusted this way, the CCL would shift northward by an average of about 2km. (현재 평균적으로 군사분계선 남쪽 8㎞ 지점에 설정돼 있는데, 국방부는 지역별 지형과 작전계획 등을 검토한 결과 민통선을 평균 6㎞ 수준으로 조정할 수 있다고 판단했다. 이렇게 조정하면 민통선이 평균 2㎞가량 북상하게 된다.)

Minister An explained the background of these measures, stating, "To respond to the changed security environment and ensure conditions for the military to focus on its core combat missions, improving regulations on military facilities has become an inevitable choice." He added, "The Ministry of National Defense and our military have devised policies that guarantee the effectiveness of military operations while enhancing the welfare of residents." (안 장관은 “변화된 안보환경에 대응하고 군이 본연의 전투 임무에 집중할 수 있는 여건을 보장하기 위해서는 군사시설 규제개선이 필연적인 선택이 됐다”며 “국방부와 우리 군은 군사작전의 실효성은 보장하면서 주민들의 편익을 증진할 수 있는 정책을 마련했다”고 이런 조처의 배경을 설명했다.)

The Ministry stated that the CCL can be adjusted to an average of about 6km, and the controlled protection zone, 90 times the area of Yeouido in Seoul, is expected to be relaxed to a restricted protection zone. Minister An explained, "We will supplement control measures such as relocating guard posts, installing barbed wire fences, and closed-circuit television (CCTV), and gradually adjust the CCL starting from 2027." (국방부는 민통선은 평균 6㎞ 정도로 조정 가능하며, 서울 여의도 90배 면적의 통제보호구역이 제한보호구역으로 완화될 것으로 예상된다고 밝혔다. 안 장관은 “민통초소 이전, 경계펜스와 폐회로텔레비전(CCTV) 설치 등 통제수단을 보완하여 2027년부터 단계적으로 민통선을 조정하겠다”고 설명했다.)

The Ministry stated that the costs of adjusting the CCL, which were previously borne by local governments, will now be fully covered by the state, as 'special compensation for special sacrifice.' They also said they would collaborate with local governments for the efficient installation, maintenance, and operation of the CCL. (국방부는 기존에 지방정부가 부담하던 민통선 조정 비용은 ‘특별한 희생에 대한 특별한 보상’ 차원에서 전액 국가가 책임지고, 민통선의 효율적인 설치·유지·운영을 위해 지방정부와 협업해 나가겠다고 밝혔다.)

The Ministry announced plans to optimize the restricted protection zone south of the MDL. The restricted protection zone refers to the area south of the CCL within 25km south of the MDL, and currently about 2,900 sq km of land in border regions is designated as such. In restricted zones, prior consultation with the military is mandatory when constructing buildings, imposing development constraints. (국방부는 군사분계선 이남 제한보호구역을 최적화하겠다고 밝혔다. 제한보호구역은 군사분계선 이남 25㎞ 범위 이내의 지역 중 민통선 이남 지역으로, 현재 접경지역 국토의 약 2900㎢가 지정돼 있다. 제한보호구역에선 건축물 신축 때 군과 사전 협의를 의무적으로 거쳐야 하는 등 개발에 제약이 따른다.)

The Ministry explained that it would improve the blanket designation criteria for the restricted protection zone south of the MDL, minimize operational review and management needs for military units, and enable regional development within limits that do not impede military operations. (국방부는 일괄적으로 지정된 군사분계선 이남 제한보호구역 지정기준을 개선해, 군부대의 작전성 검토 및 관리 소요를 최소화하고 군사작전에 지장이 없는 범위 내에서 지역개발이 가능하도록 하겠다고 설명했다.)

It is anticipated that a restricted protection zone 150 times the size of Yeouido in Seoul can be lifted. The total area of protection zones that are lifted or relaxed is expected to be about 240 times the size of Yeouido. (서울 여의도 150배 면적의 제한보호구역을 해제할 수 있을 것으로 예상되며, 해제·완화되는 보호구역의 전체 면적은 여의도 면적의 240배 정도로 예상된다.)

The Ministry stated that starting from the second half of this year, it would sequentially lift protection zones, beginning with areas where preparations are complete through operational reviews and topographical surveys by each unit. Specific regions were not disclosed on this day. A Ministry official explained, "We have a rough idea of the areas on the map, but the specific regions will be determined through military review and administrative procedures." (국방부는 올해 후반기부터 부대별 작전성 검토와 지형측량을 통해 준비가 완료된 곳부터 순차적으로 보호구역을 해제하겠다고 밝혔다. 이날 구체적인 지역은 공개하지 않았다. 국방부 관계자는 “지도상으로 해당 지역을 대략 파악했지만 구체적인 지역은 군사적 검토와 행정 절차를 거쳐 확정될 것”이라고 설명했다.)

The Ministry announced that among military obstacles such as concrete barriers and road rockfall requested for removal by local governments, 23 locations in Paju, Gyeonggi Province, and Yanggu, Gangwon Province, where military utility has decreased due to changes in the operational environment, will be prioritized for removal in 2027. A comprehensive survey will be conducted in the second half of this year to establish an annual improvement plan. (국방부는 지방정부가 철거를 요구한 용치, 도로 낙석 등 군사장애물 중 작전환경 변화로 인해 군사적 효용성이 감소된 경기 파주, 강원 양구 등의 23개소를 2027년에 우선 철거하고, 올 후반기에 전수조사를 통해 연차별 개선계획을 수립하겠다고 밝혔다.)

To improve waiting times for CCL entry and administrative delays, a CCL entry management system utilizing mobile apps and simple authentication will be established starting next year. The Ministry added that it will continue various efforts to resolve inconveniences for border area residents, such as significantly simplifying the approval process for agricultural drone flights in border regions. (민통선 출입 대기와 행정 지연을 개선하기 위해 내년부터 모바일 앱과 간편 인증을 활용한 민통선 출입관리체계를 구축할 예정이다. 국방부는 접경지역에서 농업용 드론의 비행 승인 절차를 대폭 간소화하는 등 접경지역 주민들의 불편을 해소하기 위한 다양한 노력을 지속하겠다고 덧붙였다.)

By Kwon Hyuk-chul, Reporter nura@hani.co.kr (권혁철 기자 nura@hani.co.kr)
